export_policy.privacy_scope: Allowlisted synthetic study text and hash manifests only; excludes plan PDFs, images, native-text inventories, binaries, private work content and credentials.

path_redactions.original_path_role: Absolute root of the original whole-plan-trial-20261121 experiment
path_redactions.replacement_scope: Only this host-local absolute path prefix; descendant suffixes remain unchanged.

path_redactions.original_path_role: Absolute root of the canonical skills/crown-plan-agent source used during review
path_redactions.replacement_scope: Only this host-local absolute path prefix; descendant suffixes remain unchanged.

path_redactions.original_path_role: Absolute maintained secure-runtime Python executable used during review
path_redactions.replacement_scope: Only this host-local absolute executable path.

export_policy.preservation_rule: Only the three declared host-local absolute paths are replaced in exported strings. Names, values, claim kinds, rationales and truth issue identifiers retain their original content. JSON whitespace/key order is reserialized; text retains literal UTF-8 content except declared path replacement.
export_policy.portable_json_hash_encoding: UTF-8 of json.dumps(content, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")), with no trailing newline. This hashes each embedded content object, not its containing fixture file.
export_policy.portable_text_hash_encoding: UTF-8 bytes of the embedded content string, including its original newline characters after declared path replacement.
export_policy.hash_interpretation: original_sha256 identifies the literal archived artifact. portable_content_sha256 identifies the exported content under the stated encoding. Neither denotes a newly repeated assisted review. The containing fixture file has a separate external byte hash.

archive_receipt.scope: Complete unmodified original synthetic experiment evidence, with member hashes; two later generated __pycache__ files excluded.
